'''Parr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was abducted by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Krel]] and used as a subject in his experiments; Krel hoped to create "sleeper" cyborgs. After Krel's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Havoc Squad]], the unit's [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commander]] allowed the three survivors of Krel's experiments&mdash;[[Kalyn]], [[Lox (Cold War)|Lox]], and Parr&mdash;to go free after taking their information.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parr appears in the Trooper class mission "Destroying the War Droids" on Coruscant in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]]. Players can choose to let Parr and the others leave, or kill them for dark side alignment points.<ref name="TOR" />
